server_progression.advancement.root.desc: Join the server world to receive your first advancement.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit.d: Earn any achievement in this branch.
server_progression.advancement.timespeed: Get into a bed at night and wake up in the morning.
server_progression.advancement.biomeboun: Local knowledge
Buy from a villager an enchanted book that is a seasonal, biome-specific, or other special offer.
server_progression.advancement.totem_bal: Survive a fatal hit after a Totem of Undying activates and saves you.
server_progression.advancement.veiled.de: Wear a mob or player head and let it disguise you as its owner.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_c: Shoot a block with an arrow carrying a potion effect to create a lingering cloud.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_f: Craft an invisible item frame with one item frame and one phantom membrane, then place it.
server_progression.advancement.biomeboun: The fine print
Buy from a villager an enchanted book with a curse and at least one other enchantment.
A book for the season
Buy from a villager an enchanted book marked as an offer for the current season.
server_progression.advancement.totem_bal: Try to activate another Totem of Undying before its cooldown ends.
server_progression.advancement.veiled_mo: Put on a mob head to disguise yourself as that mob.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_h: While sneaking, right-click the air with a banner in hand to wear it as a helmet.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_c: Hold a clock in either hand to display the current time in the action bar.
Bind a compass to a lodestone, then hold it and right-click another player to track them.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_d: Use a debug stick on a block to change one of its properties.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_l: Craft an invisible light from four glowstone dust and one glass block, then place it.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_c: Use a water-filled cauldron to brew a custom potion or collect one in a glass bottle.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_a: Put a potion in the cauldron, then use arrows on it to give them that potion effect.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_w: At a water cauldron, add or apply dye, wash dyed leather armour, banners, shulker boxes or supported coloured blocks, or apply a stored potion to armour.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_h: Use a honey bottle on a cauldron to add honey, or fill a bottle from honey in it.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_s: In combat, trigger Thorns or Knockback on your shield, or block an axe strike with a Quick Charge shield.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_b: Use an anvil to apply Curse of Vanishing to a bundle of any colour, then take the result.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_s: Get hit by a snowball thrown by a snow golem.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_f: While burning and without Fire Resistance, start gliding with an Elytra.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_t: Trigger the dispenser arrow trap inside a jungle temple.
server_progression.advancement.biomeboun: Two in one cover
Buy from a villager an enchanted book with at least two enchantments and no curse.
Supply creates the price
Buy a book with an enchantment already in demand in the local market; repeated purchases raise its price.
Regular customer
Open a villager's offers after earning a village-reputation discount on a book.
Today only
Open a villager's offers during the daily sale while a book offer is discounted.
After the eighth purchase
Trade with one villager the required number of times, then open their offers while a discounted special book offer is active.
Geography in your pocket
Complete a special trade with a wandering trader.
Career advice
Complete a trade from a villager whose job-specific offers have been adjusted.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_m: Try to add Mending to a mace in an anvil.
